title: Looker Alert Delivery Failures
dataSources: Looker System Activity Explores (`looker:system_activity`), Looker API (`looker:api`), and instance logs.
app: Looker System Activity (i__looker) via DB Connect or the Looker API (`/api/4.0`); Looker instance logs via Universal Forwarder; scheduled plan and query events via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=looker:system_activity source="alert"
| stats count as runs, sum(eval(status!="complete")) as failures by alert_title, owner
| where failures>0
| sort - failures
description: Tracks Looker alert condition evaluations and delivery attempts and surfaces alerts that fail to run or send, which otherwise leave stakeholders unwarned of the very conditions they set up to watch.
value: A silently failing alert is worse than no alert; monitoring delivery keeps Looker's proactive notifications trustworthy.
implementation: Ingest alert events from System Activity; schedule hourly and alert owners when their alerts repeatedly fail.
visualization: Table of alert by failures and owner.
grandmaExplanation: We make sure Looker's automatic warnings actually get sent so people are not caught out by a problem they asked to be told about.
